description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CountryDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests various methods related to retrieving country and province data from the database, using fixtures for test setup.

classes.name: CountryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of the CountryDao class in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It verifies retrieving country and province data with various criteria.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment by creating a new CountryDao instance, setting the fixture path, and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests the getCountryList method to ensure it retrieves the correct list of Country instances with expected data.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests the getProvinceList method for a specific country code, verifying correct list of Province instances.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a country by name, checking both non-existent and existing entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving a country by code, verifying both non-existent and existing entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving a province by code, validating non-existent and existing entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a province by name, validating both non-existent and existing entries.
